findings.text: route_mode is computed as one dense nested conditional; the picker branch requires picker_selection.get('backend') == backend_name as well as resolution.route == 'picker' and action == 'route', so a picker-routed dispatch whose recorded pick action was not `route` (for example a hold the operator overrode) would be labelled `shadow` rather than `picker`. A short named predicate would make the three modes auditable.

after_suite.revision names 771e46142 while the reviewed head is 7c1a4a642 and the negative control ran at 21d0195a, so neither the head arm nor the control names the reviewed head; the final commit is a docs-only fragment and an independent re-run at the head closes the tie, but the log alone does not.

the done-when names no artifact and the landing contract states a small node writes no evidence prose, yet the fragment carries a nine-row measures table; the landing anchor over-documents its measure.

item_verdicts.goal: The node makes dispatch-path picks see the codex account window and pace, makes a run's route mode durable, and makes outcomes use both. Part 1: snapshot.budget_view now fills each backend state from its budget group's freshest recorded allowance (source, observed_at, expired, headroom, utilisation_pct, burn_multiple, resets_at) and recomputes the report summary; candidates() consumes those facts, carries an explicit budget_reason (named absence or stale) when no readable reading exists, and keeps an otherwise eligible lane offered. Part 3: REVIEW_SUCCESS_SCORE=80 with `review scored N` parsed by regex so 79 fails, 80 succeeds, a failed gate still fails, and pending stays unknown. All three parts are covered by tests and my independent re-run at the committed head passed 12 tests.

justifications.goal_fidelity: All three brief items land and are tested: dispatch-path codex candidates carry the same five figures a standalone pick derives from the same recorded reading; missing and stale readings stay explicit (null fields plus a named budget_reason) without dropping eligibility; route mode is durable on the run and the ledger row with a null for legacy rows; and the review-success threshold is the named constant 80.
